full_judgment: 3. It is the case of plaintiff that suit land was originally belongs to Kumud Bandhu and Zagabandha. While they had title and possession, by registered saf kabala deed No. 8264 and 8265 dated 18-7-1960 transferred the suit land to Ali Ahmed, Nurul Islam and Umme Kulsum and delivered possession. The suit land of 'Ka' schedule recorded in SA khatian No. 255, 0.75 acre of land, originally belongs to Manik Chandra Paul in 8 annas share, Narendra Nath Paul and Binoy Krishn Paul in 4 annas share each. Narendra Nath Poul died leaving no heirs. Binoy Krishna Poul while in possession having title, transferred 0.37 acres of land by registered kabala deed No. 9721, 9825, 9825 and 9827 dated 07-12-1972 to Ali Ahmed, Nurul Islam and Umme Kulsum. 1.21 acres of land out of 1.66 acres of land of khatian No. 1804 mentioned in paragraph No. 8 of 'Ka' schedule was transferred to Ali Ahmed, Nurul Islam and Umme Kulsum and delivered possession. Ali Ahmed, Nurul Islam and Umme Kulsum by registered kabala dated 09-11-1978 transferred 2.85 acres of land to the predecessor of defendant, M/s Mannan Brothers Ltd. belongs to predecessor of defendant MA Mannan. Remaining 0.42 acres of land by purchase defendant No. 2 got title and possession. 1.15 acres of land of khatian No. 1663 mentioned in paragraph No. 6 of 'Ka' schedule was belongs to Lalita Mohon, Panchanon Das, Odhir Kumar Das and others, of them, Odhir Kumar Das died leaving sons, Milon Kant Das. Milon Kanti Das by purchase through kabala deed No. 2186 dated 17-9-1984 got some land. Later on, Lolita Mohon, Panchanon Das, Dural Chandra Das and Milon Kumar Das together sold 0.10 acres of land by registered kabala dated 29-10-1986 to Begum Shamsun Nahar, defendant No. 1 and delivered possession. Other recorded tenant, Zagabandha Das out of his share transferred 0.05 acres of land by registered deed of gift dated 25-1-1979, to his wife, Sree Shibani Rani Dasi. 0.57 acres of land of SA khatian No. 1660 mentioned in paragraph No. 5 of schedule 'Ka' was belongs to Kumud Bandhu in equal share. Zagabandhu sold his share of 0.2850 acres of land by registered deed of gift on 25-1-1979 to Shibani Rani Dasi. 3.07 decimals of land of khatian No. 1664 mentioned in paragraph No. 7 of 'Kha' schedule, 0.10 acres of land by registered kabala dated 13-1-1986 was sold to Shibani Rani. Shibani Rani Dasi by purchase got title in 0.4350 acre of land by registered deed dated 31-5-1983, sold the said land to defendant No. 1, Shamsun nahar. Out of 0.09 acres of land of present SA khatian No. 812 mentioned in paragraph No. 9 of schedule 'Ka' was purchased by Aminul Mannan and became titleless .0 5 decimals of land of SA khatian No. 637 mentioned in paragraph No. 1 of 'Kha' schedule was belongs to Begum Umme Kulsum, Dalajan and Akter Hossain who by registered kabala dated 17-3-1966 sold said the land to defendant, MA Mannan 2.5850 acres of land of present SA Khatian No. 568 mentioned in Paragraph No. 2 of schedule 'Kha' was belongs to Sudhangshu Kumar Paul and others. Said land was sold in Certificate Case No. 2861/62-63 for arrear rents and Hasina Rahman, Ayesha Bibi, Jhafmn Nessa, Basiruddin Mondal, Moazzem Hossain, Gouranga Kumar Saha, Ahammad Ali, Haidar Ali, Khorshedur Rahman, Dulin Khan and Most. Hosne Ara Begum on 25-7-1964 purchased the said land. Said auction was confirmed on 21-2-1965 and by putting the decree into execution on 12-2-1965 present petitioners got possession of the suit land, they purchased the said land in benami by Afir Uddin. Later on, from Afir Uddin, Hosne Ara got the land by registered deed dated 22-11-1969. MA Mannan purchased 0.12 acres of land of SA Khatian No. 535 mentioned in paragraph No. 3 of schedule 'Kha' belongs to Syed Murad Hossain, who by registered deed dated 12-11-1963 sold the said land to Ayub Hossain Molla. Ayub Hossain Molla in turn transferred the said land to defendant No. 1 by registered kabala dated 14-1-1964. 0.13 acres of land of SA khatian No. 1978 mentioned in schedule 'Kha' belongs to Gour Chandra and others. Gour Chandra later on sold 0.0450 acres of land by registered deed dated 28-4-1983 to Begum Shamsunnahar. Defendant No. 1 was delivered possession 0.22 acres of land of SA khatian No. 1204 mentioned in paragraph No. 5 of schedule 'Kha' was belongs to Ayub Gazi who by registered kabala dated 21-1-1971 transferred the said land to MA Mannan and his wife defendant No. 1 Begum Shamsun Nahar and delivered possession 0.30 acres of land of SA khatian No. 2242 mentioned in paragraph No. 6 of schedule 'Kha' was belongs to Abul Hossain, Abu Monzar, Kamrun Nahar, minor Sabarun Nessa and Moriam Bibi who by registered deed dated 19-8-1960 transferred 0.27 acres of land to Begum Shamsun Nahar, defendant No. 1, 0.43 acres of land of SA khatian No. 2098 mentioned in paragraph No. 7 of schedule 'Kha' was belongs to defendant No. 1.0.60 acres of land of SA khatian No. 1485 of schedule 'Ga' belongs to  Ahmed and Mosammat Umme Kulsum who by registered deed dated 9-11-1978 transferred 037 acres of land to MA Mannan 600 square foot of land under Khalishpur Police Station mentioned in schedule 'Kha' of lease deed dated 04-11-1961 was leased out to one Idris Siddique who by registered lease deed dated 27-8-1968 transferred the said plot to defendant No. 1, Shamsun Nahar and delivered possession. MA Mannan while in possession having title, died, leaving wife, defendant No. 1, Begum Shamsun Nahar., AKM Aminur Mannan, AKM Ziaul Mannan and 4 daughters, Mahmuda Yesmin, Masuda Yesmin, Nowzia Yesmin and Farzana Yesmin are defendants. In this way, defendants got 5.37125 acres of land with other lands of which they have title and possession. The aforesaid defendants for repaying their loan and having in need of cash money declared to sell the suit land and upon settlement the price of the suit land was settled at Taka 2,50,00,000; the daughters having in need of cash money, took Taka 50,00,000 from the plaintiff through cheque dated 16-6-2006 and possession was delivered to the plaintiff. It was mentioned in the baina that defendants would by 31-10-2006 mutated their names and would corrected their names and would pay the arrear rents relating to the suit land. In that baina delivery of possession was mentioned. After getting possession of the suit land, plaintiff installed M/s Reza Jute Trading Company and started business. It is also mentioned that 'Ka' schedule land divided into two parts and in between the two parts the road of Digolia running. In western sides, there are 6 godowns. Plaintiff also installed a new godown and said godowns were repaired by expending huge money. 'Kha1 schedule land also divided into two parts of them bigger part contained 0.97 acres of land and smaller part contained 0.3450 acres of land and between that two parts Satkhira road running. Although the structures on the bigger part, there was old homestead. Plaintiff by dismantling the old structure constructed new building by which old structure was totally renovated. The building in smaller part was extended and two new buildings were constructed by expending huge money. Plaintiff by expending huge money more than 60,00,000 completed the aforesaid construction. Defendants thereafter again came to plaintiff for further cash money and plaintiff through deposited scheme paid Taka 30,00,000 and 10,00,000 dated 30-4-2007 and 18-6-2007 to defendants who by encashing the cheques, got the money. Defendants besides, by different vouchers also get Taka 1,25,000 from plaintiff, in total 91,25,000 from the plaintiff. Thereafter, plaintiff demanded execution and registration of deed after taking remaining money of Taka 1,58,75,000 but the defendant on this and that plea killing time. Suddenly, defendant No. 2 on 31-3-2009 issued legal notice to the plaintiff for delivery of vacant possession of the suit property. Defendant further stated in the notice that baina dated 16-6-2006 has no legal force. Thereafter, plaintiff filed the suit.
